title: Juki LH-3568A-7
subtitle: 2-Needle, Semi-Dry-Head, Lockstitch Machine with Automatic Thread Trimmer

purposeAndApplication.purpose: The Juki LH-3568A-7 is a 2-needle, semi-dry-head, lockstitch machine in the LH-3568A series. The split needle bar allows jeans and heavy-weight variants (-G) for denim work; standard (-S) for shirts, trousers, uniforms, light jackets.
applications: 2-needle decorative seams on shirts, trousers, uniforms, light jackets
Split-bar decorative stitching where needle separation matters
purposeAndApplication.industry: Garment manufacturing (woven + knit), shirt production, trouser production, denim work

overviewDescription: Made by Juki (Japan). Series features include semi-dry head (reduced oil staining), direct-drive mechanism, organized split needle bar. Sub-models include F7WBAK135 (full-automatic with thread trimmer, backtack, wiper). Speed ceiling 3,000 sti/min across the series.

classificationTable.value: LH-3568A (sub-variants: S = medium-weight standard, G = jeans/heavy; -7 = full-automatic with thread trimmer)

resources.description: Authorized dealer product page confirming split-bar lockstitch with standard hook
